create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab surface from a Bulk structure
create_slabs_for_miller_indices: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a given Bulk structure
compute_all_slabs: compute all symmetrically distinct slabs up to a max Miller index from a bulk structure
tag_and_tile_slab_atoms: tag surface atoms and tile a slab structure to a minimum lateral size
standardize_bulk_structure: standardize a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using space group analysis
